Amendment in the Notification published in Gazette No.2001- 1,169 of the Central ProvincialCouncil by the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

I, Ediriweera Weerawardena, Minister of Road Developement, Transport, Power and Energy, Housing and Construction of theCentral Provincial Council by virtue of powers vested under the paragraph 24 of year 1992 Statute No. 4 of the PassengerTransport Authority Services, hereby announce that the paragraph 21(2) regarding the powers of the staff mentioned in theyear 2000 No. 01 passenger Transport Statute published in the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka Gazette on 26thJanuary 2001 has been amended as follows:–

"Until an approval for a separate Establishment Code and Financial Regulations is obtained for the Passenger TransportAuthority, the Establishment code and the Financial Regulations common to the public service at present will be relevant to allinstitutional and financial activities of the Authority".
EDIRIWEERA WEERAWARDENA,Minister of Road Developement, Transport, Power and,Energy and Housing and Construction,Central Province.
